activityDiagnostics.note: Not DER, conversational turn recall, word accuracy, or precision. Extra predicted activity is not penalized. NIST global mapping is reused; coverage uses original RTTM times within unioned UEM regions. Each annotated reference interval is counted once using its total retained duration, even across UEM gaps. Overlapping reference intervals remain separate in interval buckets; minority speaker-time uses their union. Forced-aligned intervals may be individual words. Protocols must be interpreted separately.

boundaryManifest.description: Synthetic sequential public LibriSpeech test-clean voices, 30s each, 3s silent gaps, first voice re-enters for 30s. Count/re-entry stress only, not a meeting quality benchmark or accurate speech-activity RTTM. Voices chosen lexicographically before inference.

mapping.basis: Optimal mapping from each arm raw acoustic intervals, separately for each reference protocol, held fixed before and after smoothing.

conditionalWordLabelAgreement.midpointRule: Score only exactly one active reference speaker; start inclusive/end exclusive; nil labels are incorrect.
limitations: One 180-second public E2E fixture; both diarizers use FluidAudio 0.17.4. This is not the 0.15.7 corpus baseline.
Agreement with acoustic reference labels at existing recognized-word midpoints; not cpWER, manually aligned word accuracy, or whole-corpus quality. ASR omissions and text errors are not measured.
One speaker accounts for 239/249 manual and 202/209 forced scored words, so a one-speaker result can score highly.
Manual and forced references exclude different words; interpret the protocols separately.
All smoothing changes in this fixture filled nil labels; no non-nil speaker label changed. This does not validate preservation of isolated brief speaker changes.
